pains.statement: Critical rules live in PDFs, scans, and email threads that auditors cannot search under deadline.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Deadline missed; corpus type and search failure story.

pains.statement: Municipal or legal archives are scanned but not indexed with reliable OCR or citations.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Query that failed; volume of corpus.

pains.statement: Compliance cannot produce cited answers from unstructured residue when regulators ask.
Teams manually copy from document stores into spreadsheets because no query layer exists.
Field definitions in documents disagree with production data dictionaries.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Field pair conflict and downstream impact.

pains.statement: Enterprise KM or 'AI search' RFPs stall; nobody scoped a cited extract for one workflow.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Cancelled RFP or pilot; no funded workstream.

pains.statement: SharePoint or file shares sprawl with duplicate policy versions and no owner.
OCR quality on legacy scans makes automated search untrustworthy for high-risk citations.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Sample page with bad OCR and business impact.
